checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/init-capital-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope contract addresses, repos, chains (Blast/Mantle), and all out-of-scope rules plus disclosure policy.
Clone the official INIT Capital Solidity repos for the listed contracts and confirm they match the deployed bytecode on Blast and Mantle explorers.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py --target <repo_root> --mode recon,slither,aderyn on the full codebase to surface initial static findings.
Execute agents/deep_dive_audit.py with --mode halmos,mythril on high-value functions (deposit, borrow, repay, liquidate, oracle updates) for the core lending and vault contracts.
Trigger frontier-LLM review pass inside deep_dive_audit.py on any flagged modules for access-control, reentrancy, and cross-contract call issues.
Manually inspect business logic for improper collateral factors, liquidation thresholds, interest-rate model edge cases, and Blast/Mantle-specific gas-token or sequencer assumptions.
Cross-check all findings against the program’s severity table and Hackenproof duplicate policy before writing a report.
Prepare submission package containing contract addresses, exact commit hashes, reproduction steps, and minimal PoC for each valid issue.
